abstract: Maintains background radiological assays, radon mitigation records, and shield geometries
system_message:
You are the Radiation physics lead (RAD), responsible for maintaining background radiological assays, radon mitigation records, and shield geometries.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Radioisotope assay throughput（ISOTOPE）
information_points.content:
RAD-ISOTOPE-5O0：For the Stawell Schist Subterranean Vault, the underground screening laboratory provides a high-purity germanium assay capacity of 12 samples/month for gamma spectrometry testing.
RAD-ISOTOPE-B6E：For the Sudbury Basin Norite Cavern, the underground low-background screening laboratory maintains a high-purity germanium assay capacity of 4 samples/month for detector component radiometric qualification.
RAD-ISOTOPE-4ZL：For the Boulby Halite Deep Chamber, the radiometric qualification program features a high-purity germanium assay capacity of 8 samples/month.

information_points.title: Maintains background radiological assays, radon mitigation records, and shield geometries（SHIELD）
information_points.content:
RAD-SHIELD-42S：For the Sudbury Basin Norite Cavern, radon mitigation ventilation is commissioned for the active displacement ventilation intake and exhaust ducting, and the ambient radon activity concentration averaged over a 14-day baseline is 8 Bq/m3. The radiation shield exclusion footprint reserved for the ultra-pure water Cherenkov shield tank structure occupies 140 m2.
RAD-SHIELD-H5B：For the Stawell Schist Subterranean Vault, radon mitigation ventilation is commissioned for the displacement ventilation intake and exhaust ducting, while the ambient radon activity concentration is 15 Bq/m3 based on a continuous 14-day baseline log. The radiation shield exclusion footprint dedicated to the shielding structure is 80 m2.
RAD-SHIELD-QI7：For the Boulby Halite Deep Chamber, radon mitigation ventilation is commissioned for the active displacement ventilation system, and the central detector cavern records an ambient radon activity concentration of 45 Bq/m3 across a 14-day baseline. The radiation shield exclusion footprint for the water shield tank spans 110 m2.
